title: Rishikesh in January 2027: Weather, Ganga Aarti, Yoga and the Kumbh Rush
seo_title: Rishikesh in January 2027: Weather, Things to Do & Tips
seo_desc: Rishikesh in January: mild days and cold, foggy mornings (about 20° / 7 °C), Ganga aarti, yoga, sunrise at Kunjapuri, day trips, and how the Ardh Kumbh in Haridwar from 14 January 2027 affects your trip.
